text: Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year.
Employees may take up to 10 days of paid sick leave each year.
Multi-factor authentication is required for administrator and remote-access accounts.
Passwords must contain at least 12 characters and must not be shared between employees.
The largest operational risk is supplier delay affecting component availability.
Revenue grew in the enterprise segment while consumer revenue remained flat.
Hotel expenses above 150 dollars per night require manager approval.
Economy class is required for flights shorter than six hours.
